name.ja: HGBD 1/144 グリモアレッドベレー

description.ja: • 『ガンダムビルドダイバーズ』第7機甲師団を率いるロンメルが操る、ミリタリー仕様のグリモアカスタム機が登場！
description.en: • ``Gundam Build Divers'' A military-spec grimoire custom machine operated by Rommel, leader of the 7th Armored Division, is now available!

description.ja: • グリモアの機能拡張をコンセプトに、各所に実践的な改修が加えられている！
description.en: • Practical improvements have been made to various parts based on the concept of expanding Grimoire's functionality!

description.ja: • 脚部のシザークロウは展開し、敵に切りかかるど派手なアクションポーズを再現可能！
description.en: • The scissor claws on the legs can be expanded to recreate flashy action poses such as cutting at enemies!

description.ja: • 独立機として機能するミニモアが2体付属し、ランドセル内に収納できる！
description.en: • Two mini-mores that function as independent machines are included and can be stored inside the school bag!

description.ja: • ライフルは分裂し、個別の武装パーツとしても装備可能！
description.en: • The rifle can be split and equipped as individual armed parts!
